title: Raccoon River Boat House operated by CanoeSport Outfitters
specs: Short portage trail from lake to river
No-wake Blue Heron Lake with many sandy beaches and fishing opportunities
All passengers and paddlers must wear properly fastened lifejackets on the water
No one under 18 may rent a boat or use shuttle service without a guardian present
No one under 14 may operate equipment alone
Swimming from boats is not permitted; swimming only from beached boats

blurb: Guests rent canoes, kayaks, paddleboats, stand up paddle boards, fishing kayaks, and bicycles at Raccoon River Park Boathouse. Rentals include paddles and lifejackets. River trips start at the boathouse beach and end at the 1st St Recreation Area boat ramp, with a short portage trail to access the river.
extraNote: All river rentals must be off the water by 6pm · Being on the river past 6:00pm results in a $100 charge · Late fees and penalties of no less than $100 for not exiting at designated boat ramp · Staff may delay opening or close due to threatening weather or winds over 20 mph · Additional shuttle fees may apply if you miss your pick-up time · Raccoon River Park Boathouse on Blue Heron Lake
